descByPlatform.flux: Wide-Angle Panorama Lifestyle Product Photograph for HYDRO 24 TRAIL water bottle alpine-vista editorial. Subject: a 24oz teal powder-coat steel bottle #1E6A6A with fresh condensation beading, a Polished Brass cap, and laser-etched 'HYDRO 24 TRAIL' in 5pt sans-serif at the shoulder, resting upright on a tan granite outcrop #A89876 with lichen speckle; mid-ground pine forest #4E5A2E receding; a distant blue ridge range #4A5E6B in high-altitude haze; Golden Hour warm side-light raking in from the west. Composition: Wide-Angle Panorama, Rule of Thirds with bottle on the left-third at 32% x, 58% y, Leading Lines along a granite crack, horizon on the top-third at 33% y, subject occupying 22% of the frame. Capture: Phase One XF IQ4 150MP with Schneider 45mm LS at f/8.0, 1/320s, ISO 100, tripod-mounted. Lighting: Golden Hour Side Lighting combined with Rim Lighting — natural sun camera-right at 25° elevation, infinity distance (key, warm); 4×4ft white bounce camera-left at 1.2m (fill on bottle); 2×3ft silver rim behind bottle at 30° catching the condensation (rim); 6×6ft black flag overhead to shape the granite. Material physics: teal powder-coat micro-matte, condensation droplet refraction, Polished Brass micro-scratches, granite feldspar speckle, pine needle cluster bokeh. Color grade: Capture One Warm-12 LUT, grain 8, +0.2 EV. Palette: teal bottle 24%, granite tan 22%, pine forest 22%, ridge blue 18%, Golden Hour sky #E6B268 14%. References: Patagonia catalogue, Outside Magazine, Chris Burkard landscape. Exclude: harsh shadows, plastic sheen, blown highlights, cluttered props, color cast.
